purpose: Held-out questions for testing E010-v4 (D_enumerate.v2-plan4-ACB.md) on questions it was not designed on. Planned: 20 clear (to be added), 20 ambiguous (TA01-TA20), 5 insufficient (TI01-TI05).
source: New questions; no exact match with pilot_questions.json, E006 P1-P10, E002 Q01-Q08 or E009 questions.rephrasing.json (highest wording similarity 0.74, from shared question endings).
format: Runner format {id, base, type, text}, as in E009-enumerate/questions.rephrasing.json. base = id (new questions, not rephrasings). Fields starting with draft_ are notes for writing gold entries; they are NOT the standard and are ignored by run_pilot.py and score_runs.py. near_original marks four questions close in subject to an original question (team decision).
